name: UNO English Pathfinder Machine-Readable Specification
source: UNO English Pathfinder Question Bank v1.3
principles: territory is separate from curricular home
professional intent is separate from intellectual profile
results are never gated by contact information
same rules should support GitHub and future QSF implementations
implementation_note: Synchronized with Pathfinder Beta v1.2.29: production Explore idle restored to 30 seconds, landing action hover decoration removed except Night mode, node expansion slowed to about two seconds with slight timing variation, jitter made modestly livelier, and autoplay category dwell increased to 15 seconds. v1.2.29 adds the Social Media resource/community hub with department, SoLaS Lab, and Writing Center social resources, and refines hover context so the hovered node foregrounds while direct relationships surface without flattening the graph. v1.2.29 adjudicates the semantic hygiene queue: Writing Center Pedagogy merges into Writing Pedagogy, Editing & Publishing capitalization is normalized, 13 reviewed pairs remain explicitly distinct, and unresolved near-duplicate candidates are zero. v1.2.30 hardens Explore English for mobile Safari with environment-aware touch messaging, explicit touch activation, shared Explore styling between overlay and standalone modes, SVG-group pan/zoom transforms, corrected mobile oscillation, and animation wake/watchdog handling. v1.2.31 preserves the v1.2.30 renderer unchanged while introducing EXPLORE! branding, a concise environment-aware invitation, an icon-only centered Night mode control, explicit desktop recommendation in the mobile entry, and corrected TESOL faculty connections to Sarah Faltin Osborn and Kevin Samejon. v1.2.38 integrates the English Dual Enrollment Certificate into meaningful verified EXPLORE! relationships with MA in English, Literature & Culture, Language & Linguistics, and Teaching & Pedagogy without changing the frozen Explore renderer. v1.2.43 removes legacy hidden Programs-to-credential edges and returns Programs & Credentials to the ordinary EXPLORE! visible-node, layout, edge, hover-isolation, and node-role conventions while preserving English plus the four category doors as its only direct neighborhood.
